## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle early-Qīng liturgical manual by **Hóngzàn** ([弘贊](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BC%98%E8%B4%8A), 1612–1686) for formal Buddhaveneration. The opening *biāotí* 標題 specifies the schedule: *huò zhòuyè liùshí, huò rì sānshí, huò chénhūn èrshí* 或晝夜六時或日三時或晨昏二時 — "[to be performed] at the six watches of day-and-night, or at the three daywatches, or at morning-and-evening." Author signature: *Guǎngzhōu Nánhǎi Bǎoxiànglín shāmén Hóngzàn biān* 廣州南海寶象林沙門　弘贊　編.

**Abstract**

The *Lǐ Fó yíshì* is the central member of Hóngzàn's threepart liturgical sequence ([KR6k0238](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0238) / [KR6k0239](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0239) / [KR6k0240](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0240)). Its programmatic claim is that **proper Buddhaveneration is essentially eulogistic** (*zàndé* 讚德, "praising the virtues"), and not merely nomenclatural recitation; the manual is constructed around *zàncí* 讚詞 stanzas which the practitioner is expected to chant with full awareness of their canonical referents. Composition is bracketed by Hóngzàn's mature *Bǎoxiànglín* / *Dǐnghúshān* career; `notBefore`–`notAfter` are 1660–1686.
